subject: Cancellation request for FitPulse Pro trial
body:
Hi FitPulse Team,

I noticed my free trial of FitPulse Pro is set to convert to a paid plan on 2026-04-07 at $14.99/month. I would like to cancel before the trial ends to avoid being charged.

Please confirm cancellation and let me know if any further action is needed.

Thank you,

subject: Request for loyalty discount on Streamvio Premium
body:
Hi Streamvio Team,

I’ve been a loyal Streamvio Premium subscriber since March 2026. I noticed my monthly rate increased from $12.99 to $17.99 this month—a 38% increase. I value the service but would like to discuss a loyalty discount or promotional rate to keep my subscription affordable.

Could you please let me know if any retention offers are available?

Thank you for your consideration.
